name: clawd
description: Clawd, the Claude mascot, thinks, types, runs and celebrates beside the thinking line, a little differently each turn

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: How lively Clawd is. still: a pose for each act and no animation, which is also what he does when Claude Code's Reduce motion is on.

puns.title: Command puns
puns.description: Act out commands: a rocket for git push, a cat for cat, ping-pong for ping. Off: he simply runs.

breaks.title: Breaks on long turns
breaks.description: Coffee, a nap, fishing and the like while a long turn is thinking.

idle.title: When Claude is done
idle.description: stay: he cheers and then waits beside the turn's last line. hide: he leaves with the thinking line.
